rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an annoying inconvenience or a troublesome incident.

example.english: This move has caused a lot of annoyance.
example.traditional: 呢次搬屋真係好多麻煩。
example.jyutping: nei1 ci3 bun1 uk1 zan1 hai6 hou2 do1 maa4 faan4

rows.note: Use this for the internal feeling of irritation or restlessness rather than for an external nuisance.

example.english: The hour-long traffic jam was a real annoyance, and I felt really irritated.
example.traditional: 塞車塞咗成個鐘，我個人好煩躁。
example.jyutping: sak1 ce1 sak1 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1 ngo5 go3 jan4 hou2 faan4 cou3

rows.note: Use this for an unwanted disturbance or act of harassment, not just an inconvenient nuisance.

example.english: Calling to sell things in the middle of the night is a real annoyance.
example.traditional: 半夜三更打嚟推銷，真係騷擾喎。
example.jyutping: bun3 je6 saam1 gang1 daa2 lei4 teoi1 siu1 zan1 hai6 sou1 jiu2 wo3
